audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagrees between layers: phases[0-2].side and phases[6].side all read "Skill" while content win[0-2]="Lulu" and win[6]="Milio", and the content whys/spikes/early text already state Lulu wins levels 1-3 (E Pix poke + Q Glitterlance out-range Milio's Q) and Milio pulls ahead on 2+ items (global R heal + W steroid spread).
audit.why: The packet levelChart (Lulu,Lulu,Lulu,Skill,Skill,Skill,Milio) and the content-layer prose both agree with each other but the full-layer side/rating never got updated to match — a self-contradicting page.
audit.corrected: Move phases[0].side, phases[1].side, phases[2].side to "Lulu" and phases[6].side to "Milio", rewriting the matching .why text for 0-2 (6's why already describes Milio winning late, so it stays).

audit.why: Power spikes are already accurately captured in content.spikes: Lulu's Lvl2 E+Q poke edge, her Lvl6 Wild Growth clutch save, item-1 peel parity, and Milio's late global-heal/steroid edge.

Core interactions are sound: Milio's E shield (2 charges) buys time against Lulu's Q Glitterlance slow, Milio's R Breath of Life cleanses her R Wild Growth knockup/CC-chain setups, and Milio's W anti-heal zone matters vs her E-Pix sustain. Whimsy (Polymorph) correctly identified as the matchup-defining disable to bait before all-in.

edits.before: Q-poke the contacts — the rebound catches the second body; bot stands in pairs.
edits.after: Her E on Pix plus Glitterlance out-range your Q kick — she wins the level-1 poke war outright.

edits.before: E-shields begin: two charges of trade insurance; count them like summoners.
edits.after: Her double-slow keeps you out of heal range while she harasses — E shields buy time, not the poke war.

edits.before: Full kit: the campfire's range gift means your duo out-ranges theirs standing still.
edits.after: Full kit online, but her E-Pix poke cadence still edges the early enchanter duel.

edits.before: - Milio vs Lulu - Track: Lulu Whimsy (Polymorph). - Track his engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - Whimsy (Polymorph) spent means windows open. - Keep the ult for the swing moment.
edits.after: - Milio vs Lulu - Track: Lulu Whimsy (Polymorph). - Track her engage cooldown — your duo trades only when it's down. - Whimsy (Polymorph) spent means windows open. - Keep the ult for the swing moment.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Helia/Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Helia/Moonstone, Swiftness, Redemption paths. Add anti-heal early into her duo’s sustain.

edits.before: Your CC plus jungler arrival decides bot — ping gank windows on his engage cooldown and hold the river bush vision.
edits.after: Your CC plus jungler arrival decides bot — ping gank windows on her engage cooldown and hold the river bush vision.

edits.before: Q the rebound through the pair, warm the carry, auto — the burn ledger compounds while the buttons wait.
edits.after: E has two charges (0.5s reset) — hold one for the poke trade and one for the all-in punish, never dump both on chip damage.

edits.before: Spending the R on a single stun — the cleanse answers chains; chains wait for it to be gone.
edits.after: Your W heal alone loses the sustain race — stack the burn passive first, then heal off the trade.

edits.before: - Lulu Whimsy (Polymorph): matchup-defining — The polymorph deletes a carry’s kit mid-fight — bait it before the real engage. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your R Breath of Life answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Lulu Whimsy (Polymorph): 18s cooldown — the polymorph deletes a carry's kit mid-fight; bait it before the real engage, and track every recast. - Your R Breath of Life (160/145/130s) answers exactly one disaster per cooldown — spend it on swing moments only.
